environment: GitVerse boohtacord-windows runner; Windows 11 local download and launch smoke
executor: Codex local Windows host and GitVerse CI
scenario: Publish a Windows x64 ZIP under a platform-specific tag with a description identifying it as a Windows build.

release.title: BOOHTACORD windows-v1.0.3 (Windows x64)
release.description_verified: The public release page states that this is a BOOHTACORD build for Windows x64 and explains whole-ZIP extraction and launching boohtacord_desktop.exe.

checks.name: GitVerse workflow and release page
checks.observation: CI run 1681164 passed testing, analysis, Windows Release compilation, packaging and GitVerse API asset upload. The public release page displays the Windows description and ZIP attachment.

checks.name: Public attachment download and ZIP integrity
checks.observation: The public attachment returned HTTP 206 for a one-byte range and downloaded fully without authentication. All 32 archive entries were readable, and extraction yielded boohtacord_desktop.exe, libwebrtc.dll and data/app.so.

checks.name: Published ZIP Windows launch smoke
checks.observation: The executable launched from the extracted published ZIP, remained running and responsive after five seconds, and displayed a BOOHTACORD window; the test process was then stopped. No account login was attempted.

checks.name: Windows authenticated and media acceptance
checks.observation: Session, voice, screen/window capture, failure rollback and second-peer behavior were not exercised.

remaining: Verify authenticated Windows use, voice and screen-sharing scenarios with a server and second peer before closing the release quality gate.
